y-m-48-02.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wuxuu ku jiraa labadaba x=2 iyo x=−2, sidaas darteed wuxuu noqdaa le'eg set-ka runta ee p.
y-m-48-02.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wuxuu ku jiraa dhammaan x ee buuxiya p, laakiin wuxuu sidoo kale ka kooban yahay qiimayaal sida x=3 oo aan buuxin p.
y-m-48-02.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Tani waa xukun nuqulaya set-ka runta {−2, 2} ee p sida uu yahay.

Erayadaada, soo koob in isla shuruud ay yeelan karto set-ka runta oo kala duwan iyadoo ku xidhan set-ka caalamiga ah. Sidee habka q loo beddelay tallaabada 3 loogu sharxi karaa sets runta?
y-m-48-02.s.s2.prompt: Sharax, adigoo isticmaalaya hal qiime oo gaar ah oo x ah, sababta aad u odhan karto 'x=2 ma aha shuruud lagama maarmaan ah x²=4' marka set-ka caalamiga ah yahay dhammaan tirooyinka dhabta ah.
y-m-48-02.s.s2.hint.0: Kala saar oo qor kee ayaa been ah weedhda: 'haddii p markaas q' ama 'haddii q markaas p'.
y-m-48-02.s.s2.hint.1: Qor dhammaan x ee buuxiya p, oo raadi mid ka mid ah kuwaas oo aan buuxin q.
y-m-48-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma cad tahay in p run tahay q na been tahay qiimaha aad dooratay?
y-m-48-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma qortay isku xidhka ah maadaama 'haddii p markaas q' ay been tahay, q ma aha shuruud lagama maarmaan ah?
y-m-48-02.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma iska ilaaliyay inaad isku qasto jihada lagama maarmaanka iyo ku filan?
y-m-48-02.s.s2.model.0: Haddii x=−2, markaas x²=4, sidaas darteed p waa run, laakiin x ma aha 2, sidaas darteed q run ma aha. Sidaas darteed 'haddii p markaas q' waa been, q na ma aha shuruud lagama maarmaan ah p.
y-m-48-02.s.s2.model.1: Qiimayaasha buuxiya p waxaa ku jira −2 iyo 2. Waxaa jira kiis x²=4 laakiin x≠2, sidaas darteed ma odhan karno q waa shuruud lagama maarmaan ah p.

y-m-48-01.s.s2.explain: x²>4 waa run marka x>2 ama x<−2. Qiyamka x<−2 (tusaale −3, −2.5, −5) waxay buuxiyaan shuruudda oo jebiyaan gunaanadka, sidaa darteed rogaalku waa been.

y-m-48-01.s.s3.o.d: Caksiga, rogan, iyo ka hortagga, midna lama xaqiijin karo inuu run yahay q oo keliya
y-m-48-01.s.s3.r.d: Ka hortag had iyo jeer wuxuu leeyahay isla qiimaha runta sida soo jeedinta asalka ah. Marka hore kala saar kee ayaa ah ka hortagga.
y-m-48-01.s.s3.explain: Ka hortag had iyo jeer wuxuu leeyahay isla qiimaha runta sida soo jeedinta asalka ah, sidaas darteed haddii q run tahay, ka hortagga "Haddii x aanu ahayn isku-dhufte 3, markaas x ma aha isku-dhufte 6" sidoo kale waa run. y-m-48-03.material: Waxaa jira laba shuruudood oo ku saabsan tiro dhab ah x. p: −1≤x≤2, q: |x−a|≤3 (a waa tiro dhab ah). Waxaan rabnaa inaan doorano a si 'haddii p markaas q' u noqdo run. y-m-48-03.s.s1.prompt: Marka 'haddii p markaas q' run tahay, maxay ka dhigan tahay P iyo Q, kooxaha x (sets runta) buuxiya p iyo q?

y-m-48-03.s.s1.r.a: Jihadu way rogan tahay. 'Haddii p markaas q' macnaheedu waa haddii p la buuxiyo, q sidoo kale waa la buuxiyaa.

y-m-48-03.s.s1.o.c: x kasta oo P ku jira wuxuu sidoo kale ku jiraa Q

y-m-48-03.s.s1.r.d: Isla tiro yeelashadu ma ka dhigto kooxaha le'eg ama mid gudaha kan kale ku habboon.
